findings.response: The matching helpers are private to the backend/proxy launchers. Defer a shared socket-helper interface to a separate serving cleanup; retain the existing bind-and-release behavior here. This campaign does not require a new abstraction or another dependency between launchers.

findings.finding: The port is free at probe time. Closing the socket releases it before the router binds, so another process can claim it.
findings.response: available_port describes the observed result at bind time, not an owned reservation. All three existing launch paths release the probing socket before startup. The native router cannot consume this socket directly. No retained incident establishes a port race; changing that serving contract is outside this correction.
